<tr class="re">
<td class="pl" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_us-gaap_OrganizationConsolidationAndPresentationOfFinancialStatementsAbstract', window );"><strong>Organization, Consolidation and Presentation of Financial Statements [Abstract]</strong></a></td>
<td class="text">&#160;<span></span>
</td>
</tr>
<tr class="ro">
<td class="pl" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_us-gaap_OrganizationConsolidationAndPresentationOfFinancialStatementsDisclosureTextBlock', window );">Organization</a></td>
<td class="text"><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Note 1. Organization</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </span></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:6pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</span></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:6pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">SLR Secured Specialty Lending Fund (the &#8220;Company&#8221;, &#8220;us&#8221; or &#8220;we&#8221;) was formed on </span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">May 8, 2026</span></span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> as a Delaware statutory trust and is an externally managed, non-diversified management investment company that has elected to be regulated as a business development company (&#8220;BDC&#8221;) under the Investment Company Act of 1940, as amended (the &#8220;1940 Act&#8221;). The Company is non-exchange traded and is a perpetual-life BDC. Furthermore, as the Company is an investment company, it applies the guidance in the Financial Accounting Standards Board Accounting Standards Codification (&#8220;ASC&#8221;) Topic 946. In addition, for U.S. federal income tax purposes, the Company intends to elect to be treated, and intends to qualify annually, as a regulated investment company (&#8220;RIC&#8221;) under Subchapter M of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended (the &#8220;Code&#8221;). As a BDC and a RIC, the Company is required to comply with certain regulatory requirements. On July 29, 2026, SLR Secured Lending Partners, LLC (&#8220;SLR Secured Lending Partners&#8221; or &#8220;Initial Member&#8221;) provided the Company with its initial seed capital of $</span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">1</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> and received </span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">40</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> common shares of the Company (&#8220;Shares&#8221;). On September 29, 2026, the Company commenced operations with the sale of </span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">6,000,000</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> common shares for $</span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">150,000</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> to an unaffiliated third-party and on September 30, 2026, the initial </span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">40</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> shares issued to the Initial Member were cancelled. The Company is managed by SLR Secured Lending Partners (&#8220;Adviser&#8221;) and SLR Capital Management, LLC (&#8220;Administrator&#8221;) provides certain administrative and coordination services to the Company. The fiscal year end of the Company is December 31.</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </span></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">The Company&#8217;s investment objective is to deliver steady quarterly income-driven returns across economic cycles while preserving capital. The Company will construct a specialty finance private credit portfolio, consisting primarily of directly originated, senior secured loans to primarily U.S. based middle market companies across four differentiated specialty finance investment strategies: (i) senior secured asset-based loans (primarily first lien) to companies with high-quality receivables, inventory, and other short-term assets (&#8220;ABL&#8221;); (ii) senior secured asset-based loans to commercial finance companies (&#8220;Lender Finance&#8221;); (iii) first lien senior secured floating rate loans and other flexible financing solutions to primarily U.S. based late stage, multi-product bio pharma/medical device companies (&#8220;Life Science Finance,&#8221; and, collectively, with ABL and Lender Finance, &#8220;Specialty Finance&#8221;); and (iv) opportunistic senior secured first lien loans to sponsor-backed middle-market companies based on cash flows generated by the borrower predominantly in healthcare as well as selective non-cyclical industries (&#8220;Sponsor Finance&#8221;) and other opportunistic investments such as participation alongside other funds managed by SLR in portfolio acquisitions and/or increases in the Company&#8217;s exposure to one or more of its core strategies (collectively, with Sponsor Finance, &#8220;Opportunistic Investments&#8221;).</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </span></p><span></span>
</td>
</tr>
